notes.title: Game release!
notes.content:
Game finally releasing, what more is to be said?
Pia and all the other girls can't wait to meet you, and pushed hard for an early release. And who can say no to Pia when she asks like this?

So Friday the 13th is the date. Sure to be a lucky launch!
